questions.subject: CALCULUS_I
questions.stem: A table gives x=0.5. Compute derivative of atanh(x) at x=0.5.
questions.explanation: Derivative of atanh is 1/(1-x^2). At 0.5 that is 1/0.75=1.3333.

questions.subject: CALCULUS_I
questions.topic: One-to-one functions and the horizontal line test
questions.stem: A table of a constant function f(x)=5 is shown. Is it one-to-one?

options.text: No, because it is not linear.
Yes, if domain has one point.

questions.explanation: A constant function maps all inputs to the same output, so it is not one-to-one. Horizontal line y=5 intersects infinitely.

questions.subject: CALCULUS_I
questions.stem: A table of f(x)= (x-3)/2 is given. Explain how to find its inverse.

answer.exemplar: Swap x and y: x=(y-3)/2, then solve y=2x+3. Thus f^-1(x)=2x+3, verified by composition.

questions.explanation: Solve x=(y-3)/2 for y to get y=2x+3. Composition confirms the inverse.
